# ui::TextColorSpan

Header: `winui/render/TextLayout.hpp`.

A range of text drawn in its own color, such as a token a syntax highlighter colored. Unlike a [TextHighlight](text-highlight.md) it only recolors: the text is drawn once, in pieces.

| Field | Type | Default | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `begin` | `std::size_t` | `0` | First byte offset into the text. |
| `end` | `std::size_t` | `0` | One past the last byte offset; an empty range colors nothing. |
| `color` | `Color` |  | The text color inside the range. |
